optimizer: separate actor and critic Adam, no gradient clipping (E1 separate_no_clip / E7), raw rewards

reference_critic.targets: discounted Monte-Carlo returns (gamma of the learner) of transitions whose episode ends inside the rollout, standardized by that rollout's mean and SD
reference_critic.use: measured out of sample: at rollout k the reference was trained on rollouts 0..k-1 only; its advantages are GAE with the learner's gamma and lambda and the learner's rewards, values replaced by the reference's

inference: seed-level jackknife-t, t(n-1), primary at 95%; equivalence by the 90% jackknife-t interval within the declared margin; seed-block percentile bootstrap (2,000 draws, seed 20261122; 40 seeds) secondary
gate: 1: D-plain with logging, seed 42 B w=0.6, reproduces E1 run 680 (separate_no_clip/raw) bit-for-bit (evaluation file and every minibatch record in updates.jsonl.gz); 2: M arm B on the same seed reproduces that D-plain run bit-for-bit, including its X4 log; 3: D-pop seed 42 B w=0.6 reproduces E7 run 360 bit-for-bit; 4: indices 0, 640 and 1280 complete with 469 X4 records

scale_matched.rule: the plain critic's output layer is wrapped as V = c * head(x) with c fixed at the arm's reward scale (B: 1, S: 7); by Adam's invariance to a constant gradient scale, S under M trains as B does apart from Adam's epsilon
